scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.db:up: docker start stuffaroo-db 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name stuffaroo-db -p 5433:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=stuffaroo -e POSTGRES_DB=stuffaroo timescale/timescaledb-ha:pg17
scripts.check:setup: uv run --directory apps/api python -W ignore -m app.doctor
scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.format: pnpm exec biome check --write . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/web exec next typegen && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
